# Synapse 2.0.8

A small fix release: every way of answering a Human step reads its fields the same way, and connecting Claude points to where Claude keeps its connectors now.

## Fixed

- **The v2 API reads a Human step's fields like everything else.** Since 2.0.7, an answer sent as text to a Human step with several fields is read one `name: value` line per field, or refused with the expected format. The app, the v1 API, the MCP server and chat channels did this; `POST /api/v2/orchestrations/runs/{run_id}/resume` still took plain text as the whole answer, so every field a later step read was missing. It now reads the text field by field, or answers `422` with the format before anything is queued. A tool call's approval and a browser turn still take plain text.
- **Connecting Claude points to the right place.** Claude moved its connectors under **Customize → Connectors**. The connect screens now say to choose **+ Add**, then **Add custom connector** there, and the Claude button opens that page.

## Install

**macOS and Linux**

```bash
curl -LsSf https://synapseorch.com/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://synapseorch.com/install.ps1 | iex
```

<details>
<summary>npm, pip or Docker</summary>

```bash
npm install -g synapse-orch-ai && synapse
pip install synapse-orch-ai && synapse         # Python 3.11–3.14 and Node.js 20.9+
```

For Docker, see [Docker](https://docs.synapseorch.com/getting-started/docker): the image is `synapseorchai/synapse-ai:2.0.8`, also `:latest`.
</details>

## Upgrading

- **From 2.0.x:** run `synapse upgrade`. Your data stays where it is, and the database is backed up first.
- **From 1.x:** run `synapse upgrade` on your 1.x install. It moves you to 2.0 the same way 2.0.0 did; read the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for what changes.

**Full changelog:** [v2.0.7...v2.0.8](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/compare/v2.0.7...v2.0.8) · [Documentation](https://docs.synapseorch.com)
